email_body:
Dear Landing team,

I'd like to apply for the Junior Brand Manager role in Ghent. I work where SEO, content and web meet, and doing that for fashion and lifestyle brands is exactly the direction I want to grow in.

At Episto I handle on-page SEO, keyword research and content for client websites, tracking performance in Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics and Search Console and turning the numbers into clear next steps. I've also built Shopify stores and WordPress sites, and my own site from scratch — so I know how the work behind a campaign actually gets done, and where things tend to go wrong early.

I'm organised, I ask questions, and I'd rather flag a risk on Monday than explain it on Friday. My Dutch is B1 written and A2+ spoken and improving; English is fluent.

I'd be glad to talk it through.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Landing team,

Your ad asks whether I get excited by fashion and lifestyle brands, whether I like figuring out why something works, and whether I take initiative. Yes to all three — and here is the work behind that.

I'm a digital marketer with a technical background. At Episto I look after on-page SEO, keyword research and content for client websites, and I track results in Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics and Google Search Console. That means I spend my days doing the thing you describe: watching how pages and campaigns perform, spotting what's working and what isn't, and writing it up in a way a client can act on. Some of those clients are e-commerce and product-driven, so I'm used to the commercial side of those numbers as well.

I also build. I designed and run my own site, baverok.com, and built mirook.com with structured data and technical SEO/GEO work that measurably raised its search-health score. For Episto I've built Shopify stores — design, product catalogue, blog content — and a WordPress site with roughly 600 member pages. That hands-on side means I can talk to developers, designers and content people without losing time in translation, and when a client asks why something dropped, I can actually go and check.

On the practical side: English is fluent and Turkish is native. My Dutch is currently B1 in writing and A2+ in speaking, and I'm working on it actively since I live in Belgium.

I want to grow somewhere small enough that input matters and senior people are close by. Landing sounds like that place, and I'd like to be useful early.

Kind regards,
Baver Ok
cv_highlights:
• Client-facing SEO and content work at Episto: keyword research, on-page SEO, blog content, and reporting results weekly with Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics and Search Console
• Commercial and e-commerce experience: built and maintained Shopify stores (harwindtf.com, custompremiumshirt.com) including product catalogue, store design and content, plus WooCommerce and WordPress client sites
• Turns numbers into recommendations: sets up tracking, audits performance, and reports clearly on what is and isn't working for client websites
• Builds with code and AI: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Python automation and daily use of LLMs to speed up research, content and audits — an Android app live on Google Play
• Organised across multiple projects at once, with a genuine appetite to learn: Semrush SEO certifications, GA4, Google Ads Search and HubSpot Content Marketing (2026), based in Belgium, English fluent and Dutch improving
